content.user_title: Create Fact-Checked GTA VI News Shorts
content.value_statement: GTA VI news Shorts require reliable sourcing, readable captions, and consistent audio and video quality. This skill provides a documented workflow with production examples and review gates.
actual_capabilities: Guides source research, fact-ledger labels, banned claims, and script checks for 30-59 second English Shorts.
Documents Kokoro sentence-level voiceover synthesis and Whisper word timestamps for script-exact captions.
Provides ffmpeg examples for still crops, trailer segments, frame counts, silence detection, and loudness measurement.
Specifies Remotion rendering guidance, colour-space correction, caption placement, and fact-card checks.
Defines independent quality review, thumbnail verification, date checks, and YouTube upload read-back procedures.
Includes three worked examples with scripts, SEO text, shot plans, technical results, and stated provenance limitations.
limitations: Requires external media tools, model files, and user-supplied source assets; no footage, music, logos, or complete Remotion project is bundled.
Scripts require a ChatGPT rewrite pass; the documented primary thumbnail route also requires an external Gemini service.
Paths and versions reflect one Ubuntu environment; some commands are templates, and several historical artifacts and rubric details are unavailable.
Human review, account authorization, and media-rights checks remain necessary; the skill guarantees neither licensing permission nor audience results.

use_cases.title: Plan a sourced news Short
use_cases.description: Organize verified claims, disputed statements, and a ChatGPT brief before committing to voiceover or editing.

use_cases.title: Build a repeatable editing workflow
use_cases.description: Coordinate sentence stems, caption timestamps, active-area crops, fact cards, and final technical checks using installed media tools.
use_cases.target_user: Video editor using scriptable production tools

use_cases.title: Review a completed Short
use_cases.description: Independently inspect delivered media, factual qualifiers, thumbnail margins, metadata, and scheduling dates before approving publication.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the production requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: List the tools, source assets, and review gates needed for my first GTA VI news Short. Do not install tools or change files.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a fact ledger and script brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these sources: [sources]. Create a fact ledger, banned-claims list, and ChatGPT brief for [topic]. Flag unsupported claims and verify dates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan captions and footage allocation
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [approved script] and [asset inventory], plan sentence stems, caption alignment, active-area crops, and the footage-pool gate. Identify missing inputs before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Audit the delivered media
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [delivered video], [ledger], and [SEO pack] independently. Measure technical gates, inspect every motion span, and recheck dates for [air date]. Do not publish.

output_examples.input: Plan a Short from supplied official sources, but the source package does not confirm an episode count.
output: Fact ledger: episode count is unannounced in the supplied sources.
Banned claim: do not state a specific episode count.
Next step: prepare the ChatGPT brief using only supported claims and clearly stated unknowns.

output_examples.input: Review a delivery report showing full-range video and missing colour-transfer metadata.
output: Release status: blocked by an unresolved colour-format defect.
Required correction: convert to limited-range yuv420p and set BT.709 colour metadata in the filter chain.
Verification: inspect the corrected file with ffprobe, then remeasure loudness and review affected frames.

output_examples.input: Reschedule a Short containing a launch countdown to a different air date.
output: Recalculate the countdown from the verified launch date and new air date.
Check the script, cards, thumbnail, and SEO for stale relative dates.
If wording changes, obtain the corrected ChatGPT line, rebuild affected media, and repeat review before scheduling.

best_practices: Trace every factual claim and qualifier to a source-ledger row, then recheck time-sensitive wording at scheduling.
Verify footage availability and active picture bounds before synthesis; inspect every selected span at full resolution.
Measure the delivered file independently and obtain owner approval before any authorized upload or schedule change.
anti_patterns: Reusing historical countdowns, reported scores, or example claims without checking current sources and provenance.
Treating small previews, render flags, or builder reports as substitutes for inspecting the delivered media.
Assuming the repository includes production assets, grants Rockstar media rights, or guarantees views or revenue.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the guidance when their environment loads skills. Media production still requires external tools.

faq.question: Does the repository include video assets or an editing project?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow documentation, command examples, and three worked examples. Supply your own assets, models, and editing project.

faq.question: Which tools are required?
faq.answer: The core workflow assumes ffmpeg, Python, Node with Remotion, Kokoro TTS, and faster-whisper. Documented paths and dependency versions need local verification.

faq.question: Can this replace ChatGPT or human review?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires a ChatGPT script pass, independent quality checks, and final owner viewing and listening.

faq.question: Does the MIT license cover Rockstar footage and music?
faq.answer: No. The repository license does not grant rights to external media. Confirm permissions separately and use appropriately licensed audio.

faq.question: Will the skill automatically publish videos or guarantee results?
faq.answer: It documents upload and scheduling steps, not a bundled publishing integration. Account actions require authorization, and no audience or income results are guaranteed.
